blocks.text: Updated at 6:55 p.m. on November 19. 2026 SHENZHEN, China — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Thursday joined fellow leaders of Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) member economies at the 33rd Apec Economic Leaders’ Meeting (AELM). The forum, held at the Shenzhen International Communication Center, gathered leaders of the 21 member economies, with Chinese President Xi Jinping as this year’s chair. READ: Marcos to Vietnamese businesses: PH ‘premier destination’ for investment Among the heads of state present are United States President Donald Trump, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney.
